subject: Relations-about-relations with typed provenance/currentness/confidence/authority/disagreement/projection-loss and bounded traversal
tests: Represent relation metadata without requiring recursive execution
Keep structural, inverse/navigation, authority, evidence, causal-hypothesis and observer/display direction distinct
Bound execution traversal independently from semantic/meta-relational depth
expected_benefit: Permit richer relation semantics without traversal explosion or accidental authority propagation.
risks: Meta-relational graphs can create traversal explosion
Inverse projections can be mistaken for semantic equivalence
wake_conditions: A receiver needs a relation-about-relation query
